page.overview:
Who is Dane Tee Dove?

Dane Tee Dove is a female Earth pony with a white coat, two-tone golden mane and tail, green eyes, and a cutie mark of a pink and purple laurel wreath. She has a minor speaking role in the season one episode The Cutie Mark Chronicles. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise.

Dane Tee Dove is identical to Laurette in all but pony type and mane color. She, along with Tall Order, Lady Gaval, Surprise, and Soarin, was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 1. Her name is syllabically the same as that of G2 Dainty Dove.

Dane Tee Dove later appears at Golden Gavel's auction during the song Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) in Sweet and Elite.

In season four, Dane Tee Dove appears in Princess Twilight Sparkle - Part 1 panicking to Twilight Sparkle when the sun and moon are frozen in the sky.
